summary_md: **Karim Masmoudi ([@Karim__Masmoudi](https://x.com/Karim__Masmoudi/status/2116267084804141118))** ships **Mudroom 0.4/0.5**, which runs coding agents in a Linux VM on a project clone: .env files and keys stay out of the sandbox copy and are never written back, and the network log attributes each connection to a command ([Kernel-Hunter/mudroom](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/mudroom)).
